event_name: Date 07 October 2018 Time 15:51 2018 JAPANESE GRAND PRIX 04 - 07 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 33 left the track at turn 16 and re-joined unsafely.
incident_time: Penalty (1 penalty points awarded, 8 points for the 12 month period)
offence: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence, and determined that car 33 locked up his brakes and left the track at turn 16, cut the chicane and rejoined track on the racing line in turn 17 and in the process collided with car 7.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 34 2018 Japanese Grand Prix Offence Car 33 Re Joinging The Track
